By consent of both sides, this Writ Petition is disposed of at the stage of admission itself.

2. This Writ Petition is filed to direct the respondents to pass appropriate orders on the appeal filed by the petitioners dated 01.07.2024 by revaluation and remeasurement of the petitioners superstructure situated in Survey No.194/1C, to an extent of 0450 sq.meters at Mathigiri Village,

https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.

Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner; learned Additional Government Pleader for the respondents 1 and 2; learned counsel for the third respondent and perused the materials available on record.
4. It is the grievance of the petitioners that their lands were acquired and an award has been passed by the second respondent dated 18.03.2024.
However, without paying the compensation, the authorities are now attempting to take possession of the property.
Hence, they seek a direction.

5. Considering the limited nature of the relief sought for in the present Writ Petition, there shall be a direction to the first respondent to dispose of the appeal filed by the petitioner dated 01.07.2024 by considering all the parameters as provided under the Act to assess the value of the superstructure and pass appropriate orders, on its own merits and in accordance with law, within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
